scriptGolden.script: const ctx = handle.GEOS_init_r(); const reader = handle.GEOSWKTReader_create_r(ctx); const wkt = 'POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0))'; const wktPtr = handle.Module._malloc(wkt.length + 1); handle.Module.stringToUTF8(wkt, wktPtr, wkt.length + 1); const geom = handle.GEOSWKTReader_read_r(ctx, reader, wktPtr); handle.Module._free(wktPtr); const areaPtr = handle.Module._malloc(8); handle.GEOSArea_r(ctx, geom, areaPtr); const area = handle.Module.getValue(areaPtr, 'double'); handle.Module._free(areaPtr); handle.GEOSGeom_destroy_r(ctx, geom); handle.GEOSWKTReader_destroy_r(ctx, reader); handle.GEOS_finish_r(ctx); return String(area);
